bib.title: PaLI: A Jointly-Scaled Multilingual Language-Image Model

read.skipped: none; reference list skimmed for lineage

question: Does jointly scaling the vision and language components, with multilingual pretraining on a 10B-image web dataset, improve a unified image+text-to-text model?
hypothesis: Scaling the vision component (a 4B ViT-e) alongside the language component gives a better return per parameter than scaling language alone.
contributions: A simple, modular encoder-decoder that reuses unimodal mT5 and ViT checkpoints
Joint scaling of language (1B to 13B) and vision (2B to 4B) components, with no saturation at PaLI-17B
Empirical support that a mixture of objectives helps
Multilingual pretraining over 100+ languages on the new WebLI dataset, with SOTA on English-only tasks retained

method.summary: PaLI feeds output patch features of a ViT (no pooling) as visual tokens to an mT5 text encoder-decoder, with all tasks cast as image+text to text. Language component is updated and the ViT is frozen during one epoch over a 1.6B-example multilingual mixture at 224x224; PaLI-17B gets an extra 10k-step 588x588 phase with all parameters updated. Models are then fine-tuned per task.
method.task: image+text to text pretraining (captioning, VQA, OCR, detection, span corruption) and per-task fine-tuning

datasets.name: WebLI (top 10% by cross-modal score)
datasets.size: about 1B examples kept from 9,624,017,440 instances (10B images, 12B alt-texts, 109 languages, 29B image-OCR pairs)
datasets.preprocessing: near de-duplication of images against train/val/test of 68 vision/V&L datasets (0.36% removed); filtered by image-alt-text cosine similarity, keeping the top 10%

datasets.name: Pretraining mixture (8 tasks)
datasets.size: 1566M examples: text-only 100M, WebLI alt-text 1000M, OCR 100M, CC3M-35L 100M, VQA 100M, VQG 100M, object-aware 50M, detection 16M
datasets.source: WebLI, CC3M-35L, VQ2A-CC3M-35L-100M, Open Images, Visual Genome, Objects365

datasets.name: COCO Captions (Karpathy), NoCaps, TextCaps, VizWiz-Cap, Crossmodal-3600, VQAv2, OKVQA, TextVQA, VizWiz-QA, ST-VQA, xGQA, MaXM
datasets.preprocessing: TextCaps/TextVQA/VizWiz/ST-VQA fine-tuned with OCR strings from a public service, ordered top-left to bottom-right

other.note: training mixture and hyperparameters slightly different from other sizes

training.objective: teacher-forced softmax cross-entropy over text targets (language-model style)
training.lr: peak 1e-2 for PaLI-3B; 5e-3 for PaLI-15B and PaLI-17B
training.steps: high-res phase 10k steps (10M examples); main pretraining steps not stated
training.hardware: PaLI-17B: 1,024 GCP TPUv4 chips, four-way model partitioning; high-res phase 512 TPUv4 chips
training.wall_clock: 7 days pretraining plus 3 days high-res phase

other.resolution_224: all variants pretrain at 224x224; ViT frozen, only language component updated
other.high_res_phase: PaLI-17B only, 588x588, 10k steps, batch 1024, all parameters updated, mixture reduced to OCR, CC3M-35L and VQ2A equally weighted; 2D bilinear upsampling of positional embeddings, patch size unchanged
other.finetune_resolution: PaLI-3B and 15B at 490x490; PaLI-17B at 588x588 unless stated; xGQA/MaXM 17B pretrained at 224 and fine-tuned at 378; Crossmodal-3600 at 224
other.finetune_hparams: batch size 256 (searched over {128,256,512}), peak LR {1e-5,3e-5,1e-4} searched; steps 20k COCO/NoCaps, 10k TextCaps, 5k VizWiz-Cap, 20k VQAv2, 5k TextVQA/VizWiz-QA/OKVQA/ST-VQA; LR 3e-5 for COCO/NoCaps and OKVQA, 1e-4 for the rest; linear decay to zero
other.vit_e_training: JFT-3B, batch 16,384, 224x224, 1M steps, initial LR 0.0008, inverse sqrt decay with linear cool-down to zero over final 100k steps, model soup of two cool-downs (with and without inception crop), big_vision

inference.samples: single run per setting; no seeds reported
inference.prompting: template prompts per task, e.g. 'Answer in EN: [question]'; zero-shot ImageNet scores all 1,000 class names with the decoder using 'Generate alt_text in EN at 2: Photo of <extra_id_0>'

other.vqa: open-vocabulary generation with exact match, 250k mT5 vocabulary

metrics.name: CIDEr
metrics.definition: consensus caption score; Crossmodal-3600 after unicode normalisation and punctuation removal, neural segmenter for zh/ja/ko/th

metrics.name: VQA accuracy
metrics.definition: exact match of generated answer (ANLS for ST-VQA)

metrics.name: 7-task average
metrics.definition: mean of COCO-Cap, NoCaps, TextCaps CIDEr and VQAv2, TextVQA, OKVQA, VizWiz-QA accuracy as plotted in Fig 2; exact aggregation and fine-tune resolution per bar not stated

eval.protocol: single fine-tuned checkpoint per task; PaLI-17B without the high-res phase evaluated for the scaling comparison; no seeds or significance tests

availability.code: not released; built on open T5X, big_vision
availability.weights: not available (model card: research prototype, not public)
availability.data: WebLI not released; datasheet in Appendix G

prompts.text: detect cat and dog and leopard
Generate alt_text in EN at 2: Photo of <extra_id_0>

evidence.quote: This phase is only for 10k steps, covering 10M examples in total, with all the parameters of PaLI updated.

results.claim: Scaling the vision tower ViT-G to ViT-e (+2B params, ~13% of the model) adds 3.2 points to the average over seven benchmarks.
results.setup: PaLI-15B to PaLI-17B, no high-res phase for 17B, 224 pretrain, seven V&L benchmarks of Fig 2
results.note: Text does not name the two checkpoints compared; per-task bars are only in Fig 2
results.quote: the average performance improvement over all seven benchmarks (additional +3.2) is larger than the one obtained with much larger increases in the capacity of the language model (+3.1)

results.claim: Scaling the language side mT5-L to XXL (+12B) adds 3.1 points on the same seven-benchmark average.
results.setup: PaLI-3B to PaLI-15B presumed (ViT-G fixed); same seven benchmarks
results.note: '+3.1' printed in the same sentence as the 3.2; baseline checkpoints inferred from Fig 2 legend

results.claim: The 588x588 high-resolution phase adds 2.0 points on the seven-benchmark average for PaLI-17B.
results.setup: PaLI-17B, 10k extra steps (10M examples), all parameters updated, simplified mixture
results.note: Bundled effect: higher resolution plus unfrozen ViT plus a different mixture plus 10M more examples; fine-tune resolution of the non-high-res 17B bar not stated
results.quote: The high-resolution pre-training phase at 588×588 resolution brings an additional +2.0 points

results.claim: PaLI-17B reaches 149.1 CIDEr on COCO Karpathy test, the best without CIDEr optimisation.
results.setup: COCO Captions Karpathy split, PaLI-17B at 588x588
results.quote: establishes a new high of CIDEr score (Vedantam et al., 2015) at 149.1
results.table: Table 1, row PaLI-17B, column COCO Karpathy-test

results.claim: PaLI-17B scores 84.3 on VQAv2 test-dev in open-vocabulary generation.
results.table: Table 3, row PaLI-17B, column VQAv2 test-dev

results.claim: Adding ViT-e to mT5-L (PaLI-5B) gives +0.9 improvement per 1B ViT params versus +0.2 per 1B mT5 params for L to XXL.
results.setup: COCO-Cap and OKVQA at 490 res; PaLI-3B, 5B, 15B, 17B
results.note: PaLI-17B vs 15B: +2.2 per 1B ViT params; vs 5B: +0.4 per 1B mT5 params; RoI computed from COCO and OKVQA only
results.table: Table 12, rows PaLI-5B and PaLI-15B, column Improvement per 1B more params

results.claim: ViT-e is only marginally better than ViT-G on ImageNet but gives about three more COCO CIDEr points in PaLI.
results.setup: mT5-XXL paired with ViT-e, no high-res phase, COCO
results.quote: ViT-e yields almost three additional CIDEr points over ViT-G on the COCO captioning task.
ViT-e achieves 90.9% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet

results.claim: PaLI-17B zero-shot ImageNet top-1 is 72.11%, above 15B at 70.27%.
PaLI-17B keeps language-only quality close to mT5-XXL: SuperGLUE 88.2 vs 89.3.
Initialising from unimodal checkpoints matters: from scratch PaLI-3B scores 72.8 COCO CIDEr vs 141.4.
results.table: Table 14, row From scratch, column COCO

results.claim: Removing the VQG objective drops the zero-shot VQG score from 96.7 to 17.9.
results.table: Table 6, row w/o VQG, column VQG (ZS / FT)

results.claim: Dropping non-English WebLI cuts multilingual caption quality: 8.2 (6L) with English-only WebLI vs 41.9 with the full mix.
results.table: Table 16, row only WebLI-en, column XM-3600

results.claim: PaLI-17B averages 53.6 CIDEr over 35 Crossmodal-3600 languages vs 47.0 for PaLI-3B.
Pretraining cost for PaLI-17B: 1,024 TPUv4 chips for 7 days, plus 512 chips for 3 days for the high-res phase.

limits: Open-vocabulary VQA scoring counts paraphrases and synonyms as wrong (E).
Multilingual ability is partly lost when fine-tuning on English-only data (E).
Without OCR input PaLI falls behind (TextVQA 58.80 vs 73.06 with OCR); the authors guess the large vocab makes OCR string generation harder (C.5).
The high-res gain is one bundled phase with changed mixture and unfrozen parameters, not a resolution-only ablation, and is shown only for PaLI-17B.
The 3.2 vs 3.1 comparison names no checkpoints in text and has no seeds or intervals; PaLI-5B used a slightly different mixture and hyperparameters; ViT-e benefit is smaller with mT5-L (OKVQA +1.4).
Weights, code and WebLI are not released.
